_comment: 🔮️ This subset's own contribution to the repository test platform: the `image` 0.25 reference codec registered specifically for JFIF 1.01 mutation coverage (distinct from the shared `image-jpeg` entry's `jpg-raster` capability), the exhaustive JpgMutation vocabulary it is measured against, and the coarse-tolerance comparison profile a lossy round trip through two independently written codecs needs.

oracles.rationale: The reference JPEG encoder/decoder of the Rust ecosystem, registered here under its own mutate-scoped capability (the shared `image-jpeg` entry is scoped to raw `jpg-raster` creation and does not cover this subset's typed JpgMutation vocabulary). This subset's own codec (../🚪️io/🦀️component.rs) is a from-scratch baseline JPEG implementation, not an `image` wrapper, and deliberately regenerates fresh Annex K DQT/DHT tables at `re_encode_quality` on every encode rather than preserving whatever tables a mutation set on the decoded snapshot, and never emits DRI/restart markers at all — so SetQuantTable/RemoveQuantTable/SetHuffmanTable/RemoveHuffmanTable mutate only the in-memory snapshot model (provably absent from the re-serialized bytes) and SetRestartInterval is unobservable in any re-encode. The oracle therefore proves what the format actually guarantees survives a real mutate-and-reencode round trip through an independent implementation: geometry and gross raster content for the mutations that touch pixels, and simple decodability for the mutations that only touch metadata/tables/segments a conformant decoder does not need to reproduce.

productionDebt.plan: Same underlying `image` crate reachability already recorded against the shared `image-jpeg` entry (✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio/🧪️oracle/🔣️component.json) — repeated here because the dependency gate keys recorded debt by (path, oracle id) pair, not by package, so a second oracle id sharing the same package needs its own record. Phase 7 target: both call sites want raster decode/encode that ✏️s/🔌️plugins/🗄️stdio already implements, so routing them through decode_bmp / decode_tiff / decode_jpg retires the dependency and every entry recording it, this one included.

comparisonProfiles.description: JFIF 1.01 JPEG mutation round trips compared by geometry plus an 8-bucket luma histogram (never raw samples: JPEG is lossy and this platform's comparison tolerance is per-number and absolute, with no aggregate mode). The reference `image` codec and this subset's own from-scratch codec are two independently written implementations, so a real photographic fixture re-encoded through each lands luma mass in the same coarse buckets but not identical per-bucket pixel counts; the tolerance below is sized against the ~5.8 megapixel real-world fixture this case reads (asset shared://🖼️abbau-aufbau-masterarbeit-grundriss.jpg) so genuine corruption (wrong geometry, blank/inverted/solid output, wildly shifted tonal balance) still fails while double-JPEG rounding noise between the two codecs does not.
